claims.text: A five-storey building housing a boys' paying guest accommodation in Satya Niketan collapsed on Sunday afternoon, killing seven people and injuring several others.
Harteerath Singh Ahluwalia of the Hemkunt Foundation announced that Gurdwara Moti Bagh is offering free shelter and food to students displaced by the Satya Niketan building collapse.
Delhi Police arrested property owner Urmila Gupta, her husband Hariram Gupta, and their son Mahesh Gupta on charges of culpable homicide and negligence following the building collapse.
Labour contractor Sanoj was apprehended by police in Kasganj, Uttar Pradesh, for questioning in connection with the Satya Niketan collapse.
The Satya Niketan building was undergoing basement repairs and ground-floor commercial extension renovation work when it collapsed.
A Supreme Court bench of Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R Mahadevan agreed to examine PG building collapses and safety concerns across India.
Satya Niketan experienced a previous building collapse in April 2022 that killed two people and injured four others.
Bhupendra Jaj, whose son Arpit died in the Satya Niketan building collapse, urged parents not to send their children to Delhi to study.
The family of deceased student Arpit Jaj donated his undamaged eye to a patient in need following his death in the collapse.
Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta instructed the Municipal Corporation of Delhi to demolish a dilapidated building adjacent to the collapse site in Satya Niketan.
The Municipal Corporation of Delhi demolished 24 properties and sealed seven illegal structures across Delhi following the Satya Niketan collapse.
The Municipal Corporation of Delhi suspended South Zone deputy commissioner Rakesh Kumar and four engineers pending disciplinary proceedings.
Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu ordered a structural audit of all buildings in paying guest accommodation hubs within a week.
The Delhi High Court criticized Delhi University and municipal authorities for failing to provide adequate hostel facilities, forcing students into unsafe paying guest accommodations.
A Delhi High Court bench comprising Chief Justice DK Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia directed the MCD to inspect all paying guest accommodations and submit a compliance report within a week.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the seventh edition of the Global Fintech Fest and urged the fintech ecosystem to expand UPI's global reach.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India's economy achieved 7.8 per cent real GDP growth in the June quarter despite challenges from the West Asia conflict.
Real-time payment transactions using UPI reached 24.51 billion as of August.
The UPI platform is currently live in 11 countries and is linked with Singapore's local payment system.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged the fintech industry to focus on non-payment transactions, including access to savings products, pensions, and insurance.
Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded India's sovereign credit rating to 'A-' from 'BBB+', its first such upgrade for India in three decades.
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated at the Global Fintech Fest that Indian fintech firms have reshaped finance by taking banking directly into the hands of every citizen.
